snapshot.title: AIT-611 Residual Recovery — 08:00

fields.subject: FW: AIT-611 Residual Recovery — 08:00
fields.note: Confirmed recovery of chlorine residual at the Orchard Standpipe outlet. The system has been under manual control with Carver County Water flowing in since 07:50. This confirms that disinfection has been restored. The loss of residual has been reversed. I recommend proceeding with advisory issuance under Section 4.4 Level 3, as the conditions for lifting have not yet been met and the 24-hour sampling window remains active.
fields.signature:
Marcus Oyelaran
Water Quality Manager
City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

original.subject: AIT-611 Residual Recovery — 08:00
original.body: The grab sample taken at the Orchard Standpipe outlet (AIT-611) at 08:00 shows chlorine residual at 0.6 mg/L. The system has been under manual control with Carver County Water flowing in since 07:50. This confirms that disinfection has been restored. The loss of residual has been reversed. I recommend proceeding with advisory issuance under Section 4.4 Level 3, as the conditions for lifting have not yet been met and the 24-hour sampling window remains active.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the recovery of disinfection. The WQ Manager is now authorizing the advisory release, which should trigger the final public announcement. Watch for the team to validate the recovery against the manual operation logs and confirm that the 24-hour sampling window has not yet closed.
